# CLOSEOUT: observed offline implementation evidence

This assessment retains `byte_pin_authority=false`. EC-CLOSEOUT acceptance is
blocked on independent controller/display evidence, approved review publisher
bindings and the provisional input. No live-provider qualification, release,
merge or Gate A dispatch is claimed by this receipt.

Producer rows record actual serial ai outcomes and production symbol witnesses.
The optional xdist-only scratch check is explicitly unavailable in the locked
environment and supplies no passing proof. Source-only installed-workflow skips
are reported separately in the runner handoff. Historical SCHEMA, ENVELOPE,
JOURNAL and WORKER receipts keep their original bytes and outcomes.

The tested head and entire governing-content identity precede this receipt-only
stamp. The stamp head is observed externally. Applicability requires the
verifier's ancestry/delta or authenticated squash-correspondence proof.
Hosted Gate A remains coordinator-owned; missing hosted identities remain null.
The coordinator authorized SL-0's single stamp-test adaptation to fresh synthetic
data; historical validators and the stamp implementation remain unchanged.
